notes: What the iOS app may declare, read by scripts/security_scan.sh ios (MA-363). Anything not listed here is refused: an App Transport Security exception, a background mode, an entitlement key or value. Every entry carries its reason; add one only with the change that needs it.
The mode runs on the laptop only (MA-166: no iOS build or Swift analysis on GitHub Actions). Its selftest is scripts/security_scan_selftest.sh, run on planted fixtures with this file.
The entitlements below are the planned ones (ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.5, section 8.4 'One site, two jobs'); the app has no entitlements file yet.

debug_only.NSAllowsLocalNetworking: The Debug build reaches the local stack on the Mac (scripts/local, MA-198). The 'Stamp the build' build phase in ios/MyPaisa.xcodeproj deletes the key from every configuration but Debug, and the Release app's Info.plist is refused here if it still carries it.

aps-environment.reason: Push notifications through APNs (ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.5: each signed-in device keeps its push token).

com.apple.developer.applesignin.reason: Sign in with Apple, natively (ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.5).

com.apple.developer.associated-domains.reason: The dashboard serves the app's apple-app-site-association file: applinks open invite and holding links in the app, webcredentials let one passkey work in the app and the web app (ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.5 and section 8.4). The relying-party id is the dashboard's domain, which MA-109 confirms.

keychain-access-groups.reason: Tokens live in the Keychain, this device only (ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.5); each app keeps to its own group, never a shared one.

deny.reason: The local stack's API (scripts/local). Only a Debug build reaches it, through MYPAISA_API_URL at launch; nothing in the Release app may name it.
The local stack's API by address, as above.
The dev API. The Release app is prod, compiled against api.mypaisapp.com (ios/Config/Prod.xcconfig); dev's host anywhere in it means a dev setting leaked in.
The probes' compilation condition is set for MyPaisa Dev only (ios/Config/Dev.xcconfig).
The local sign-in stub's launch hook (MA-198) is Debug only. scripts/ios_gates.sh already refuses it in the Release binary, so it is checked here in the JavaScript bundle only.

checked_by_ios_gates: scripts/ios_gates.sh (its 'prod' step) already refuses these in the Release app, so they are not repeated here: MYPAISA_API_URL, MYPAISA_AUTH_STUB, MYPAISA_STATIC_MOTION, MYPAISA_VIEWPORT_WIDTH and mpProbe in the binary; auth/local in main.jsbundle; the bundle id, the base URL and the build epoch in Info.plist.
release_bundle.canaries_note: Swift keeps a string of 15 bytes or fewer inline in the code, not as text, so `strings` cannot see it: the binary's canary must be longer (MPApiBaseURL, 12 bytes, was never found; MA-363). The same limit applies to a deny-listed Swift literal of 15 bytes or fewer, so short deny strings are caught in the JavaScript bundle and the plist, not reliably in the binary.
